featured_reviews.name: Akshata Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an overwhelming experience in this villa. Surprise planned by friends was worth it. What a place and what a view. It’s way too beautiful and amazing. The bedrooms are so clean and very well maintained. And the food cooked by our Chef was super tasty. Each and every item made by him was  very tasty. I would highly recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Muskan Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text: Overall, I had a wonderful time at the villa; the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating, and the amenities were excellent. The room was lovely, tidy, and ideal for a celebration. The accommodations were spotless and really comfy, and the service was outstanding. They went above and above to make our stay as pleasant as possible. Anyone going downtown should definitely stay at this villa.

featured_reviews.name: Jhalak Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at Celeste green planet villas for 2 nights with friends. Had an amazing weekend!
The villa is very well maintained, and proper cleanliness is maintained. The caretaker and the chef did a wonderful job and took care of all our needs. Also whatever I needed for my baby was very well taken care off!
Overall had a wonderful time.

featured_reviews.name: rushikesh atre
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited the villa with friends and family in June 2021. The villa absolutely does justice to the pictures and your expectations.. It is absolutely clean, neat and very well maintained.. The cook makes delicious food. You may find the food cost a bit expensive, but the food is delicious. We had veg n non veg n both were tasty... The pool is small but nice n clean. The bedrooms are comfy. One bedroom is small and good for children. The villa has a big terrace/ balcony on the 1st floor. The villa is not very big but comfortable. We would definitely go there again...!!

featured_reviews.name: pradeep shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: This villa is huge and the view it enjoys is breathtaking. The scenery around is even more beautiful during sunrise and sunsets. The rooms are extremely spacious and terrace facing Pawna lake makes you wonder if you can ever leave this place. The food prepared by the house cook is scrumptious and more flavourful because of lot of love and care he adds to it. A must visit place, you won’t regret it!

featured_reviews.name: sanjana gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: The villa is really big and amazing. Located at a nice and cozy location with good view. Has a good pool and amazing rooms with bath tub. The food is good too. The only problem is with hot water, sometimes it's an issue, but overall is a great place to visit with groups and even for couples.

featured_reviews.name: V K
featured_reviews.review_text: Stayed here with a group of friends in the third week of December.. Property was really good. Chef was excellent especially during dinner with the barbecue & stuff. Rooms & bathrooms are clean. Plus the owner keeps frequenting to the bungalow checking if everything is okay. Will visit again for sure..
